review_cases.summary: An inquiry arrived about an unrecognized login and credit usage.

inquiry_data.subject: Unrecognized login
inquiry_data.body: There was an unrecognized login and credit usage. (fictional inquiry)

review_questions.prompt: Did the login mentioned in the inquiry succeed? / 問い合わせにあったログインは成功したか？
review_questions.source_kind: Login history / ログイン履歴
review_questions.source_field: Result of the target login / 対象ログインの結果

review_questions.prompt: Did the user answer that they did not perform the login? / 本人は「自分が行ったログインではない」と回答したか？
review_questions.source_kind: Verified inquiry / 本人確認済みの問い合わせ
review_questions.source_field: Answer about the login / ログインに関する回答
